blockWrapper: div.<name>-wrapper inside main .section.<name>-container; block carries .block + data-block-name
buttonizationNote:
decorateButtons() requires an authored / around the link, the link alone in its

, no inside, and a text that is not the URL itself
sectionMetadata: server-side (style -> section classes, other keys -> data-*); scripts/aem.js decorateSections still folds a client-side section-metadata block when present

chrome.header: loadHeader() -> blocks/header (block reads nav metadata, else /<country>/<lang>/nav from the pathname, else /us/en/nav)
chrome.footer: loadFooter() -> blocks/footer (same resolution with footer metadata / <locale>/footer)
chrome.navHeight: --nav-height 200px (>=1025px) / 130px (<=1024px): the fixed header's rendered height, the in-flow reservation replaces the source's .root padding-top

fontsLoading: loadFonts() loads styles/fonts.css after first paint (desktop or fonts-loaded session flag eagerly, else in loadLazy)
